desc: Derive and verify the sweep counting formula: L(r) = max(lo+1 over pairs with hi ≤ r); count = Σ (r - L(r) + 1) = Σ (r - max1) with max1 baseline 0.
Design gain attribution: at each r, if cnt1 == 1, pair idx1 gains (max1 - max2); pairs sharing max1 get zero gain.
Implement grouping of pairs by hi (bucket array of size n+1) and a sweep maintaining max1, max2, cnt1, idx1 of (lo+1) values.
Compute base total of valid subarrays with all pairs in O(n + m).
Accumulate per-pair gains and combine: answer = base + max(gains, default 0).
Test against both examples and edge cases (duplicate pairs, m=1, no constraint relaxation possible) plus brute-force cross-check on small random inputs.
Write final solution in the starter code with complexity O(n + m) time and O(n + m) space.
